acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO for a home service business in New York City can vary significantly based on several factors, including the scope of services, the competitiveness of your local market, and the desired level of engagement. Packages can range from basic local listing optimization to comprehensive AI-driven content creation and technical SEO. It's best to request a customized quote after an initial assessment of your specific business needs and marketing goals to ensure the solution aligns with your budget and expected ROI.
